# Perform the Shapiro-Wilk test for normality
from scipy.stats import shapiro

# Conduct the test
statistic, p_value = shapiro(per_dem_clean)

print("Shapiro-Wilk Test Results:")
print(f"Test Statistic: {statistic}")
print(f"P-value: {p_value}")

# Set significance level
alpha = 0.05
print(f"\nSignificance level (alpha): {alpha}")

# Determine normality based on p-value
if p_value < alpha:
    normality_status = "not normal"
    print(f"\nP-value ({p_value}) < alpha ({alpha})")
    print("Result: Reject the null hypothesis")
    print("Conclusion: The data is NOT normally distributed")
else:
    normality_status = "normal"
    print(f"\nP-value ({p_value}) >= alpha ({alpha})")
    print("Result: Fail to reject the null hypothesis")
    print("Conclusion: The data is normally distributed")

print(f"\nNormality Status: {normality_status}")
